# Employee Leave Policy

Policy ID: HR-POL-012. Owner: People Operations. This policy explains paid time off (PTO) and other leave types.
See the [leave request portal](https://hr.example.com/leave-portal) to submit requests.

## Leave Entitlements

Full-time employees accrue leave according to the table below.

| Leave type | Annual entitlement | Requires documentation |
|---|---|---|
| Annual leave (PTO) | 20 days | No |
| Sick leave | 10 days | Yes, after 3 consecutive days |
| Parental leave | 16 weeks | Yes |
| Bereavement leave | 5 days | No |

Part-time employees accrue leave pro rata based on contracted hours.

## Carryover

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year.
Carried-over days expire on March 31 of the following year.

### Exception for Approved Projects

As an exception, employees whose leave was cancelled by a manager because of an approved critical project may carry over up to 10 days. The exception must be approved in writing by the department head and recorded in the HR system before December 31.

## Requesting Leave

1. Submit the request in the leave portal at least 2 weeks in advance for absences longer than 3 days.
2. Your manager approves or declines within 5 business days.
   - If no response is received, escalate to HR at hr-help@example.com.
3. Emergency leave may be requested retroactively within 2 business days.
